actions_taken: Audited all six top-level xyz.artiji/commerce fields and separated field-category gaps from merchant-chosen values.
Drafted a minimal normative MPP-over-MCP addition binding the existing receipt to taskId and preserving the same receipt values across tasks/get and notifications/tasks.
Generated deterministic byte-exact HTTP entity-body vectors for challenge, paid success, replay, working poll, and completed poll.
Detected that the original fixture used a reduced task shape, documented the limitation, and stopped short of calling those vectors conformance evidence.
On operator-approved revision, added the per-request Tasks capability, current task discriminators and lifecycle fields, terminal CallToolResult nesting, and task routing headers.
Regenerated the vector set and added reproduction assertions for request headers, task shapes, terminal resource correlation, every body hash, and byte-identical replay.
Updated the 249-word issue #292 follow-up and all material limitation statements without posting externally.
key_results: All 6/6 extension fields remain SPEC_GAP at the field-category level; their eight scalar values remain merchant-specific.

Discovery does not compose cleanly for the required paid deferred-service terms, while the runtime flow still depends on implementation-defined idempotency, claim, receipt-binding, and artifact-correlation rules.
The minimal upstream change needs no new field and belongs only in MPP-over-MCP transport composition, not MPP core or the Stripe method.

The revised task flow uses resultType=task for creation, resultType=complete for polling, required lifecycle fields, terminal result nesting, client capability declaration, and polling routing headers.
Paid success and replay are byte-identical, use one fake provider request, and preserve the same receipt values through working and completed polls.
The full P1-P6 revised suite passes 16/16 tests.
The regenerated vectors are credible single-implementation task-wire evidence, not a complete MCP server or multi-implementation interoperability suite.

assumptions_made.assumption: SPEC_GAP classifies a missing interoperable field category, while each merchant remains responsible for the value and policy content.
assumptions_made.invalidation_condition: Reviewers define merchant-specific to include every standard category whose value is selected by a merchant.

assumptions_made.assumption: The same Payment Receipt means the same logical receipt values carried under the existing org.paymentauth/receipt key, not byte-identical JSON serialization and not new identity or settlement fields.
assumptions_made.invalidation_condition: The transport draft defines a different receipt replacement, refresh, or lifecycle model.

assumptions_made.assumption: The five-vector scope can demonstrate the tools/call task creation and tasks/get wire path without claiming complete MCP Tasks extension support.
assumptions_made.invalidation_condition: Reviewers require server/discover, cancellation, subscriptions, notifications, or a second implementation before accepting any scoped task-wire evidence.

scope_creep_surfaced: A complete MCP server, server/discover exchange, tasks/update, tasks/cancel, and notification subscription transport were not added.
The six discovery gaps were not folded into the receipt lifecycle diff; they require separate design work.
Historical P3-P5 trace exports were not rewritten to look like post-revision runs.
No public issue comment or pull request was posted.
No hosted gateway, second Stripe payment, refund, dispute, or settlement-finality work was added.
next_phase_readiness_reason: The six-phase plan and the approved bounded P6 task-wire revision are complete. The draft and vectors are ready for scoped review; external publication remains an explicit operator action.

revision.reason: The operator selected Option 1 after P6: correct the current MCP Tasks wire mismatch and regenerate the evidence before publication.
